title: selectCOMP Class
summary: Official Derivative Python API reference for Select COMP instances, documenting that the class has no operator-specific Python members or methods and relies on inherited PanelCOMP / COMP behavior.
guidance: Use this article to avoid inventing Select COMP Python members or methods when the official class page does not document operator-specific API.
For Select COMP panel values, hierarchy, focus, mouse/touch simulation, or component utilities, use inherited PanelCOMP and COMP behavior.
Do not treat inherited PanelCOMP members such as panel or panelParent() as selectCOMP-specific methods.
